Cherubi

Grass

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Cherubi is a Grass-type Cherry Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 3.3 kg. It evolves into Cherrim. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (62), with a base stat total of 275.
